rows.explainer:
GiveWell's shortcut for programs that save children's lives without modelling their later income: the income gain is 0.30647 times the value of the deaths averted, the ratio in its AMF and SMC models (2023–2024). Some sheets round it to 0.31; New Incentives' March 2025 renewal uses 0.3197.
